text:
As of 2017, the leading cause of death in children under five was complications of preterm birth, according to Global Burden of Disease estimates. Lower respiratory infections (pneumonia) and neonatal encephalopathy/birth asphyxia and trauma were close behind. Estimates vary by source and by how causes are grouped, so some analyses (for example, grouping neonatal conditions together) would frame the answer differently.

CONFIDENCE: 72
